issues.legal_issue: Prior sanction under Section 197 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is not required for prosecuting a public servant for alleged fabrication of records that is not part of, or reasonably connected with, the discharge of official duties.

A refusal to grant sanction does not justify quashing the entire complaint and chargesheet where the alleged conduct may fall outside official duties, particularly when other accused persons are also charged.
A person who unsuccessfully challenged a complaint in an earlier proceeding cannot challenge that complaint again in a later quashing petition.
